name: Pull of the Void (Recharge 5–6)
description: The creature sends Void tendrils at up to three creatures it can see within 60 feet of it that are not behind total cover. Each target must succeed on a DC 16 strength Saving throw or be pulled up to 30 feet toward the creature. Then each creature within 5 feet of the creature takes 36 (8d8) force damage.
